sn47.10:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena aññataro bhikkhunupassayo tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi || || 2.
sn47.10:1.2: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhuniyo yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Ānandam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho tā bhikkhuniyo āyasmantam Ānandam etad avocuṃ || || 3.
sn47.10:2.1: Idha bhante Ānanda sambahulā bhikkhuniyo catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittā viharantiyo uḷāram pubbenāparam visesaṃ sampajānantī ti || ||
sn47.10:2.2: Evam etam bhaginiyo evam etam bhaginiyo ||
sn47.10:2.3: yo hi koci bhaginiyo bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacitto viharati || tassetam pāṭikaṅkham
sn47.10:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando tā bhikkhuniyo dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi || || 5.
sn47.10:3.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Sāvatthiyam piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattam piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn47.10:4.1: Idhāham bhante pubbaṇhasamayam nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena aññataro bhikkhunupassayo tenupasaṅkamiṃ || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdiṃ || ||
sn47.10:4.2: Atha kho bhante sambahulā bhikkhuniyo yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā mam abhivādetvā ekam antam nisīdiṃsu || ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho bhante tā bhikkhuniyo mam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn47.10:4.3: Idha bhante Ānanda sambahulā bhikkhuniyo catusu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittā viharantiyo uḷaram pubbenāparam visesaṃ sampajānantī ti || ||
sn47.10:4.4: Evam vuttāham bhante tā bhikkhuniyo etad avocuṃ ||
sn47.10:4.5: Evam etam bhaginiyo evam etam bhaginiyo
sn47.10:4.6: yo hi koci bhaginiyo bhikkhu va bhikkhunī vā catusu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacitto viharati || tassetam pāṭikaṅkham uḷāram pubbenāparaṃ visesaṃ saṃjānissatī ti || || 6.
sn47.10:5.2: yo hi koci Ānanda bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā catusu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacitto viharati || tassetam pāṭikaṅkham
sn47.10:6.2: Idhānanda bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam || ||
sn47.10:6.3: Tassa kāye kāyanupassino viharato kāyārammano vā uppajjati kāyasmim pariḷāho cetaso vā līnattam bahiddhā vā cittaṃ vikkhipati || ||
sn47.10:6.4: Tenānanda bhikkhunā kismiñcid eva pasādaniye nimitta cittam paṇidahitabbam ||
sn47.10:6.5: tassa kismiñcid eva pasādaniye nimitte cittam paṇidahato pāmujjaṃ jāyati ||
sn47.10:6.11: Yassa khvāhaṃ atthāya cittam paṇidahiṃ so me attho abhinipphanno
sn47.10:6.13: So paṭisaṃharati ceva na ca vitakketi na ca vicāreti ||
sn47.10:6.14: Avitakkomhi avicāro ajjhattaṃ satimā sukhamasmī ti pajānāti || || 8--9.
sn47.10:7.3: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.10:7.4: tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato dhammārammaṇo vā uppajjati kāyasmiṃ pariḷāho cetaso vā līnattam bahiddhā vā cittaṃ vikkhipati || ||
sn47.10:7.5: Tenānanda bhikkhunā kismiñcid eva pasādaniye nimitte cittam paṇidahitabbaṃ ||
sn47.10:7.6: tassa kimiñcid eva pasādaniye nimitte cittam paṇidahato pāmujjaṃ jāyati ||
sn47.10:7.12: Yassa khvāham atthāya cittam paṇidahiṃ || so me attho abhinipphanno ||
sn47.10:7.14: So paṭisaṃharati ceva na ca vitakketi na ca vicāreti ||
sn47.10:7.15: Avitakkomhi avicāro ajjhattaṃ satimā sukhamasmī ti pajānāti || || 11.
sn47.10:7.16: Evaṃ kho Ānanda paṇidhāya bhāvanā hoti || || 12.
sn47.10:8.2: Bahiddhā Ānanda bhikkhu cittam apaṇidhāya Apaṇihitam me bahiddhā cittan ti pajānāti || ||
sn47.10:8.3: Atha pacchāpure asaṃkhittaṃ vimuttam Apaṇihitan ti pajānāti || ||
sn47.10:8.4: Atha ca pana kāye kāyānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā sukhamasmī ti pajānāti || || 14.
sn47.10:8.5: Bahiddhā Ānanda bhikkhu cittam apanidhāya Apaṇihitam me bahiddhā cittan ti pajānāti || ||
sn47.10:8.6: Atha pacchāpure asaṃkhittam vimuttam Apaṇihitanti pajānāti || ||
sn47.10:8.7: Atha ca pana vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā Sukham asmī ti pajānāti || || 15.
sn47.10:8.8: Bahiddhā Ānanda bhikkhu cittam apaṇidhāya Apaṇihitam me bahiddhā cittan ti pajānati || ||
sn47.10:8.9: Atha pacchāpure asaṃkhittam vimuttam Apaṇihitanti pajānāti || ||
sn47.10:8.10: Atha pana citte cittānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā sukhamasmīti pajānāti || || 16.
sn47.10:8.11: Bahiddhā Ānanda bhikkhu cittam apanidhāya apaṇihitam me bahiddhā cittanti pajānāti || ||
sn47.10:8.12: Atha pacchāpure asaṃkhittaṃ vimuttam Apaṇihitanti pajānāti || ||
sn47.10:8.13: Atha ca pana dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi || ātāpī sampajāno satimā sukhamasmīti pajānāti || || 17.
sn47.10:8.14: Evaṃ kho Ānanda apaṇidhāya bhāvanā hoti || || 18.
sn47.10:9.1: Iti kho Ānanda desitā mayā paṇidhāya bhāvanā desitā apaṇidhāya bhāvanā || ||
sn47.10:9.2: Yam Ānanda satthārā karaṇīyam sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampam upādāya || kataṃ vo tam mayā || ||
sn47.10:9.3: Etāni Ānanda rukkhamūlāni etāni suññāgārāni nijjhāyathānanda mā pamādattha ma pacchāvippatisārino ahuvattha || ayaṃ vo amhākam anusāsanī ti || || 19.
sn47.10:10.2: attamano āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinandī ti || ||
